description: This is a JUnit test class for OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter in the OpenMRS project. It contains two test methods that verify bean creation behavior based on OpenMRS version profiles.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter based on OpenMRS version profiles.

methods.name: match_shouldCreateBeanForOpenmrs1_8AndLater
methods.description: Verifies that the bean OpenmrsComponent1_8 is created for OpenMRS 1.8 and later versions.

methods.name: match_shouldNotCreateBeanForOpenmrs1_6To1_7
methods.description: Verifies that NoSuchBeanDefinitionException is thrown when attempting to get OpenmrsComponent1_6To1_7 bean, indicating it is not created for versions 1.6 to 1.7.
